description: Broad weakly informative candidate priors for per-arm monotone Bayesian Binomial-logistic dose-DLT curves. alpha is the log-odds at the geometric mean observed dose; eta is transformed by softplus to obtain a non-negative slope per natural-log dose ratio. The candidates retain different sensitivity-analysis centers, but all use broad standard deviations so sparse historical cohorts are less strongly pulled toward a preselected toxicity level or slope. Compare candidates on frozen validation data before choosing one for a target curve.

prior_policy.name: broad_weakly_informative_normals_v2
prior_policy.interpretation: Proper regularizing priors are retained for stable Laplace fitting; they are deliberately broad rather than flat or improper.

very_low_toxicity.description: Broad weakly informative sensitivity prior centered on unusually low reference-dose DLT risk and a shallow positive dose increase.

low_toxicity.description: Broad weakly informative sensitivity prior centered on low reference-dose DLT risk and a modest positive dose increase.

phase1_moderate.description: Broad weakly informative Phase-I sensitivity prior centered on low reference-dose DLT risk and a moderate positive dose increase.

target_dlt_25.description: Broad weakly informative sensitivity prior centered on 25% DLT probability at the geometric-mean observed dose, with a moderate positive dose increase.

flat_dose_response.description: Broad weakly informative sensitivity prior centered on a near-flat positive dose response.

steep_dose_response.description: Broad weakly informative sensitivity prior centered on a steeper positive dose response.

weakly_informative.description: Default broad weakly informative prior centered on 25% reference-dose DLT risk with a neutral latent slope; intended to let observed cohort data dominate whenever they are adequate.
